NoWorkflows.note: Dashed border-border frame, min-h-40, centred heading on text-heading, max-w-sm description on the muted role, and a secondary Button action with a Plus icon.

LoadFailure.note: Error-shaped copy with a Retry action — the same layout carrying a different intent, which is how the product uses it.

TitleOnly.note: Title-only render: description and action slots collapse cleanly, the dashed frame keeps its min height rather than shrinking to the text.

InsidePanel.note: Nested inside a bordered card with its own header — shows the dashed empty frame reading correctly against a bg-card surface, not just on the page background.
